episode.title: Building A Glowing Crystal Cottage From Scratch! 🛠️✨

synopsis: A magical fairy-tail cottage built with embedded glowing quartz crystals rises within an enchanted forest clearing.

shots.prompt:
A fresh exterior scene in a wide view whose position and angle stay fixed, with a slow zoom as its single movement. An empty lot is graded, then road, fence and landscaping are laid out, then the foundation is marked. The builder arrives with materials.

Moist forest earth littered with pine needles is cleared. Stone masonry footings are laid in a circular formation, and bundles of hand-carved oak beams and raw quartz crystals arrive on a timber wagon.

The same fixed exterior view continues from the previous final frame, with a slow zoom as its single movement. Foundation, walls and roof frame rise inside that same composition with accelerating timelapse energy and satisfying material flow.

Curved oak timber posts lock onto the stone foundation. Timber rafters form a high arched roof frame while stacked river stone walls rise with embedded glowing raw crystals catching warm sunlight.

The same fixed exterior view continues from the previous final frame, with a slow zoom as its single movement. Cladding, roof, paint, exterior lighting and landscaping are finished until the completed exterior stands clearly in frame.

Moss-covered wood shingles cover the roof dome. Smooth mortar seals the stone facade, warm lanterns mount beside arched wooden entryways, and lush flowering vines with cobblestone pathways surround the fairytale exterior.

A fresh interior wide scene whose position and angle stay fixed, with a slow zoom as its single movement. Interior walls go up, flooring is laid, utilities and lighting infrastructure are installed, carrying the exterior's materials and design language inside.

Inside the circular earthen interior, hexagonal wooden floor tiles are installed. Hidden warm backlight channels align along curved stone walls, and exposed ceiling beams are fitted with iron hanging hooks.

The same fixed interior view continues from the previous final frame, with a slow zoom as its single movement. Furniture and decor are installed, the lighting comes up, and the interior is finished until it looks ready to live in.

A hand-carved stone fireplace with glowing crystals is built against the back wall. Plush velvet seating, raw edge wooden tables, and glowing crystal lamp fixtures complete the whimsical, warm interior space.

Continuing from the previous final frame, the viewpoint is released for one unbroken move that begins inside, passes through a door or window, and settles on a wide exterior of the finished structure while the builder keeps working.

Moving gracefully from the cozy fireplace hearth, the shot drifts through the arched timber doorway into the verdant forest glade, revealing the full glowing stone cottage as the builder sweeps the stone patio.

music: Acoustic wooden percussion with organic marimba taps, soft shaker rhythms, and warm cellos. The steady construction rhythm aligns with timber work and crystal placement. At the end of shot 5, the percussion dips for a calm breath before blossoming into a rich acoustic string crescendo in shot 6, finishing softly.
